pool.domain: Unit 6 · Fundamental Theorem of Calculus & Definite Integrals
pool.text: Primary oscillator [APAB-0] operates under the relation the differentiable function \( f(x) = 2x^2 + 4x \). What is the instantaneous derivative \( f'(3) \)?
pool.sol: By the power rule, \( f'(x) = 4x + 4 \). Substituting \( x = 3 \) gives \( f'(3) = 4(3) + 4 = 16 \).

fig.title: Curve f(x) = 2x² + 4x and Tangent at x = 3

pool.domain: Unit 6 · Fundamental Theorem of Calculus & Definite Integrals
pool.text: Evaluate the definite integral of the constant function: \( \int_{2}^{5} 9 \, dx \).
pool.sol: The antiderivative is \( 9x \). Evaluating from \( 2 \) to \( 5 \) gives \( 9(5 - 2) = 27 \).

pool.text: Let \( G(x) = \int_{5}^{x^{3}} \sqrt{t + 2} \, dt \). By the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, what is \( G'(x) \)?
